Nightly etl/reconcile/report (plus refit-blend on Sundays). launchd, not cron: cron drops triggers while the Mac sleeps; launchd runs a missed StartCalendarInterval on next wake (lesson from mlb_tb_line). cron_job.sh reconciles a 3-day lookback so a late run still covers the missed slate.
Hour/Minute are system-local (America/Los_Angeles): 01:30 PDT = 04:30 ET, after West Coast games end and stats.nba.com box scores settle. Inside mlb_tb_line's 22:50-07:50 keep-awake bridge.
